1.11.1 and 1.1.5 are discussed in different issues and the topic here is that they seem to overlap.

I think 1.11.1 and 1.1.5 are clearly separate requirements
* 1.1.5 - document the (external) services the application **need to use**
  * further discussion for the requirement can be carried in #993
* 1.11.1 - document the services the application **provides**

So from overlap perspective I think there is no problem to solve and we can close the issue. (Before closing, need to check do we need to carry proposals from https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/issues/1184#issuecomment-1378298598 to other issues)
